UniquePassives.Name: Vampire
UniquePassives.Description: Leeches 30% physical damage as HP.

UniquePassives.Name: Time Collector
UniquePassives.Description: Reduces cooldowns by 0.1s on basic attack.

UniquePassives.Name: Depression Chaos
UniquePassives.Description: Deals 200% INT magic damage on casting a non-damaging AOE skill.

UniquePassives.Name: Thorn
UniquePassives.Description: Reflects 10% of damage taken scaling with STR back to the attacker.

UniquePassives.Name: Mana Leech
UniquePassives.Description: 30% chance to leech mana on hit.

UniquePassives.Name: Execution
UniquePassives.Description: Instantly execute targets whose HP <= 5%.

UniquePassives.Name: Blood Bleeding
UniquePassives.Description: 20% chance to apply a Bleeding DOT dealing 1% Max HP + 1% (INT + DEX) damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Bleeding
UniquePassives.Description: Ticking DOT dealing 1% Max HP per second.

UniquePassives.Name: Curse of Kanix
UniquePassives.Description: Swaps core stats: INT <-> STR, DEX <-> VIT, LUK <-> AGI.

UniquePassives.Name: Blessing of Magearna
UniquePassives.Description: 40% damage absorbed by Mana.

UniquePassives.Name: Blood Mage
UniquePassives.Description: Use HP instead of Mana, skills deal 30% more final damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Eldritch Faith
UniquePassives.Description: INT -50%, adds flat damage equal to lost INT.

UniquePassives.Name: Rock
UniquePassives.Description: Immune to pushes and impulses.

UniquePassives.Name: Double Attack
UniquePassives.Description: Every basic attack strikes twice. Basic attacks only.

UniquePassives.Name: Double Spell
UniquePassives.Description: Level 1 skills cast a second time for free; the second cast deals 60% less damage. Stacks with Echo Spell.

UniquePassives.Name: Iron Momentum
UniquePassives.Description: Damage grows while you keep hitting the same target. Switching targets resets it.

UniquePassives.Name: Burden of Kings
UniquePassives.Description: ATK rises with carried weight, but movement slows with it.

UniquePassives.Name: Last Banner
UniquePassives.Description: Gain a temporary shield the first time HP falls below half in a fight.

UniquePassives.Name: Anvil Heart
UniquePassives.Description: You cannot critically hit, but every attack deals your average critical damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Verdict
UniquePassives.Description: Hits brand enemies. Your next attack detonates the brand as Holy damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Penitent Blade
UniquePassives.Description: Part of your STR counts as INT for Holy skills.

UniquePassives.Name: Heretic's Pyre
UniquePassives.Description: Enemies that die while branded spread fire to nearby foes.

UniquePassives.Name: Oath of Silence
UniquePassives.Description: You cannot use skills with a cast time, but instant skills hit far harder.

UniquePassives.Name: Spellbound Edge
UniquePassives.Description: After a successful cast, your next basic attack carries that skill's element.

UniquePassives.Name: Quickened Weave
UniquePassives.Description: Each basic attack shortens the cast time of your next skill.

UniquePassives.Name: Runic Skin
UniquePassives.Description: Gain temporary resistance to the element of your last skill.

UniquePassives.Name: Twin Conduit
UniquePassives.Description: ATK and M.ATK merge into one value, but two-handed weapons cannot be equipped.

UniquePassives.Name: Marked Throat
UniquePassives.Description: Attacks from behind a target always critically hit.

UniquePassives.Name: Veil Step
UniquePassives.Description: Become briefly invisible after dodging an attack.

UniquePassives.Name: Venom Ledger
UniquePassives.Description: The more status effects a target has, the more damage you deal to it.

UniquePassives.Name: One Clean Cut
UniquePassives.Description: Your first hit on a target is massive. Later hits weaken until you switch targets.

UniquePassives.Name: Loaded Chamber
UniquePassives.Description: Standing still loads a special round. Your next shot grows with the time stored.

UniquePassives.Name: Powder Burn
UniquePassives.Description: Critical hits set the target on fire.

UniquePassives.Name: Ricochet Doctrine
UniquePassives.Description: Shots that kill an enemy bounce to the next one.

UniquePassives.Name: Six Fates
UniquePassives.Description: Attacks roll one of six outcomes, from a miss to enormous damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Windreader
UniquePassives.Description: Damage increases with distance to the target.

UniquePassives.Name: Pinning Shot
UniquePassives.Description: Repeated hits briefly pin the target in place.

UniquePassives.Name: Skirmisher's Pace
UniquePassives.Description: Shoot while moving without slowing down, but with shorter range.

UniquePassives.Name: Hollow Quiver
UniquePassives.Description: No automatic basic attacks, but every aimed shot hits hard and pierces.

UniquePassives.Name: Overflowing Sigil
UniquePassives.Description: MP restored beyond your maximum is stored as power for your next skill.

UniquePassives.Name: Glass Cannon Theorem
UniquePassives.Description: The more MP you have left, the higher your M.ATK.

UniquePassives.Name: Slow Incantation
UniquePassives.Description: Long casts grow stronger with the cast time actually spent.

UniquePassives.Name: Singular Element
UniquePassives.Description: Choose one element. It becomes far stronger and all others are unusable.

UniquePassives.Name: Hexweaver
UniquePassives.Description: Curses stack on a single target and grow with each stack.

UniquePassives.Name: Fickle Stars
UniquePassives.Description: LUK sets the chance for a skill to cost no MP.

UniquePassives.Name: Whisper Pact
UniquePassives.Description: Power rises with Corruption, but maximum HP falls.

UniquePassives.Name: Grave Tithe
UniquePassives.Description: Enemies dying nearby restore a little HP.

UniquePassives.Name: Bone Choir
UniquePassives.Description: Skeletons dying in range rise as temporary allies.

UniquePassives.Name: Hollow Crown
UniquePassives.Description: Maximum HP is halved, but life leech can exceed maximum HP.

UniquePassives.Name: Volatile Mixture
UniquePassives.Description: Potions you use explode in a ring around you.

UniquePassives.Name: Second Dose
UniquePassives.Description: Potions have a chance not to be consumed.

UniquePassives.Name: Transmuted Blood
UniquePassives.Description: Items that restore HP also restore MP.

UniquePassives.Name: Living Philosopher
UniquePassives.Description: You cannot use potions, but HP regenerates steadily with VIT.

UniquePassives.Name: Answered Prayer
UniquePassives.Description: Self-healing grows stronger the lower your HP is.

UniquePassives.Name: Radiant Rebuke
UniquePassives.Description: Healing releases a Holy wave that damages nearby enemies.

UniquePassives.Name: Vow of Stillness
UniquePassives.Description: Standing still grants M.DEF and faster MP recovery.

UniquePassives.Name: Covenant Keeper
UniquePassives.Description: All healing is greatly increased, but you can only deal Holy damage.

UniquePassives.Name: Pack Instinct
UniquePassives.Description: The more summons you have, the faster you move and attack.

UniquePassives.Name: Shared Wound
UniquePassives.Description: Your summons take part of the damage dealt to you.

UniquePassives.Name: Feral Bond
UniquePassives.Description: Summons gain a bonus from your DEX and VIT.

UniquePassives.Name: Alpha's Burden
UniquePassives.Description: You can have only one summon, but it grows larger and much stronger.
